boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to absorb ideas, values, beliefs, rules, or attitudes so that they become part of one's own thinking, feelings, or identity
ops.cn: 内化；把思想、价值观、信念、规则或态度吸收为自身思维、情感或身份的一部分

ops.en: relating to, based on, or offering an interpretation or explanation of meaning, significance, or evidence
ops.cn: 解释性的；诠释性的；与意义、重要性或证据的解释、理解有关的

ops.en: the act of becoming involved in a situation, process, conflict, or condition in order to alter its course or outcome
ops.cn: 干预；介入；为了改变某个局势、过程、冲突或状况的发展或结果而参与其中

ops.value: Medical, policy, educational, and other interventions are applications of the general involvement-to-alter-course meaning; improvement may be a goal but is not part of the core definition.

ops.en: the state or quality of being invalid, not legally effective, not logically sound, or not factually valid
ops.cn: 无效性；不合法律效力、不合逻辑或不符合事实真实性的状态

ops.en: participation, engagement, connection, or concern in an activity, situation, relationship, organization, or process
ops.cn: 参与；投入；牵涉；与活动、局势、关系、组织或过程发生联系或参与其中

ops.en: the lawmaking body or assembly of a state, country, or other political jurisdiction, composed of legislators
ops.cn: 立法机关；由立法者组成、负责制定法律的国家、州或其他政治辖区的机构或议会

ops.en: a broad family of political traditions emphasizing individual liberty and rights, equality before the law, and limits on or reforms of political and economic power, with priorities varying across liberal traditions
ops.cn: 自由主义；一组广泛的政治传统，通常强调个人自由与权利、法律面前平等，以及对政治和经济权力的限制或改革；不同自由主义传统的具体侧重点有所不同

ops.value: Use a neutral, tradition-aware definition; liberal traditions differ across time and place and should not be reduced to a single policy axis.

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same noun.

ops.en: the process of reducing restrictions, controls, or regulation, or making a system, policy, or market more liberal
ops.cn: 自由化；放宽限制、控制或监管，使制度、政策或市场更开放的过程

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to reduce restrictions, controls, or regulation, or make rules, policies, markets, or systems more liberal or open
ops.cn: 使自由化；放宽规则、政策、市场或制度中的限制、控制或监管

ops.en: the skillful handling, operation, control, or alteration of something
ops.cn: 操作；处理；熟练控制、运用或改变某物

ops.en: the act of controlling or influencing another person unfairly, covertly, or deceptively for one's own purposes
ops.cn: 操纵；以不公平、隐蔽或欺骗方式控制、影响他人以达到自身目的

ops.en: the state of being fully developed, grown, or mature physically, mentally, socially, or in another relevant sense
ops.cn: 成熟；充分发展；在身体、心理、社会等方面达到成熟状态

ops.en: finance/law: the date or state at which a debt, bond, investment, or other obligation becomes due or payable
ops.cn: （金融/法律）到期；债务、债券、投资或其他义务应当偿付的日期或状态

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to counteract something so that it becomes ineffective, harmless, or unable to produce its usual effect
ops.cn: 抵消；使失效；使无害；通过反作用消除某物原有影响

ops.en: chemistry: to make a substance chemically neutral, especially by reacting an acid with a base or vice versa
ops.cn: （化学）中和；使物质在化学上呈中性，尤指酸碱相互反应

ops.en: to render a threat, agent, device, or force harmless or ineffective
ops.cn: 使威胁、装置、力量等失去危害或作用

ops.en: the state or condition of being normal, usual, or regular, or a return to such conditions
ops.cn: 正常状态；常态；恢复到通常、正常状况的状态

ops.value: Statistical normality is a specialist branch of conformity to a normal distribution and should not define the general noun.

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to make or bring something to a normal, usual, or standard condition, level, form, or relationship
ops.cn: 使正常化；使恢复或达到正常、通常或标准状态、水平、形式或关系

ops.en: the quality or practice of basing judgment on observable evidence and relevant facts rather than personal feelings, preferences, or bias
ops.cn: 客观性；依据可观察证据和相关事实而非个人情感、偏好或偏见作判断的品质或做法

ops.en: the act of taking part in an activity, event, process, discussion, decision, or shared effort
ops.cn: 参与；参加活动、事件、过程、讨论、决策或共同工作的行为

ops.en: continuing, recurring, or remaining for a long time; of a person, continuing determinedly despite difficulty or opposition
ops.cn: 持续的；反复出现且长期不消失的；（人）面对困难或反对仍坚持不懈的

ops.en: the act or process of predicting a future event, result, or development
ops.cn: 预测；预言未来事件、结果或发展的行为或过程

ops.en: a statement, forecast, or result saying what someone expects will happen in the future
ops.cn: 预测结果；预言；对未来会发生什么作出的陈述或预报

ops.meaning_cn: 关于未来会发生……的预测或预言

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to decide that something is more important than other things, or arrange tasks, needs, or goals in order of importance
ops.cn: 优先处理；确定优先级；按重要性排列任务、需求或目标

ops.en: an estimate or forecast of a future amount, result, trend, or condition based on available data or assumptions
ops.cn: 预测；估算；基于现有数据或假设对未来数量、结果、趋势或状态作出的推算

ops.en: the act of projecting an image, light, or information onto a surface, or the image produced in that way
ops.cn: 投影；把图像、光或信息投射到表面的行为，或由此形成的图像

ops.en: psychology: attributing one's own feelings, motives, or qualities to another person or group
ops.cn: （心理学）投射；把自己的情感、动机或特质归到他人或群体身上
